---
title: Define a trademark/naming policy for "Muninn"
labels: needs-human,licensing,docs,P3,phase:now
---
## Why human

AGPL grants code freedoms but no trademark rights (`docs/MARKET_POSITION_2026-06.md` §7.6). Whether and how to assert the name — and whether to pursue registration — is a personal/legal decision with cost implications. `docs/BRAND_NAMING_CONTRACT.md` already exists as the natural home.

## Steps

1. Decide the policy: forks must rename (strong, GPL-ecosystem-normal) vs. attribution-friendly use. Recommended baseline: "Forks and modified distributions must not use the Muninn name or icon in a way that implies endorsement; unmodified redistribution may keep the name."
2. Add the policy section to `docs/BRAND_NAMING_CONTRACT.md` + one line in README near the license section.
3. Optional: consult on TM registration (likely disproportionate now; revisit at 50K installs).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Policy decided and committed; README references it
- [ ] Decision (incl. "no registration for now" if so) recorded in the doc
